EC1: - History of symptomatic cerebral infarct [AND] with functional deficit (pre-stroke modified Rankin Scale score ≥1) to measure the impact of the infarct [AND] and selective neuronal loss on long-term outcome without being biased by pre-existing deficits.
EC2: - History of severe cognitive impairment (dementia) [OR] or DSMIV axis 1 psychiatric disorders that would confound the neurological evaluations.
